answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as a quill of commitment to the network state. An attacker must acquire a pearl of significant economic value to gain voting power, rendering the cost of deploying millions of fake identities prohibitive. By tying consensus weight to an opal reserve of staked assets, the system forces an adversary to bear the financial burden of their own subversion, ensuring that identity remains scarce and costly.
